title: Unify latency-aware retry profiles and add lightweight StreamOperator shim across Py/TS/Go SDKs
author: Marcus Li
description: Motivation: Customers running inference across unstable networks (mobile/edge) see bursty p95/p99 spikes that cause suboptimal retry decisions (either aggressive retries causing overload or conservative backoffs hurting latency). This PR introduces a latency-aware retry profile that adapts backoff floors using short-term p95 latency windows and exposes a small StreamOperator shim to normalize streaming cancelation / graceful-drain semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Summary of changes: 1) Add network-aware retry profiles (LatencyAwarePolicy) and a lightweight metrics window used by the retry controller. 2) Introduce StreamOperator: a minimal cross-language adapter that provides Pause/Resume/Abort semantics and a consistent onClose reason propagation so SDKs behave identically when servers send partial error frames or mid-stream reauth redirects. 3) Ergonomic wrappers: Python convenience helpers (backoff presets + decorator), TS fluent builder for retry policies, and Go factory method for embedding LatencyAwarePolicy into existing client constructors. 4) Parity fixes: ensure session headers (x-rw-session, x-rw-lease) and retry metadata are forwarded on reconnect paths; align TypeScript streaming event envelope with Python/Go. 5) Docs, end-to-end integration tests, and microbenchmarks added. Compatibility notes: - Non-breaking by default: existing retry behaviors remain the same unless a LatencyAwarePolicy is explicitly enabled. - SDK version bumps: python -> 1.14.0, typescript -> 1.27.0, go -> 1.8.2. - No protocol changes to the server; shim operates client-side. Testing & validation: - Unit tests for policy decision logic and StreamOperator state machine included. - Integration tests simulate packet loss, reauth frames, and slow tails. - Benchmarks show median cost per token unchanged, p95 latency reduced 6-11% under simulated 10-20% packet loss. Rollout plan: - Canary enablement in Redwood Dedicated cluster with runtime flag for 2 weeks. - Gradual opt-in for Hosted API customers via SDK flag. - Telemetry: added retry_policy.name, retry.window_ms, stream.operator.events to debug traces. Checklist: - [x] Implementation in py/ts/go SDKs - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs + examples - [x] Benchmarks and CI green - [x] SDK version bumps and changelogs
